streams.name: Choose and Complete an Ownership Partnership
streams.description: A founder and investment team agree whether a buyout or pre-exit partnership fits, then close only after financing, governance, and diligence conditions are satisfied.
outcomes: Founder liquidity and role match the signed agreement
The company enters ownership with a funded, accountable value plan

flows.title: Choose and Complete an Ownership Partnership
flows.description: Proposed service flow; approval and authority boundaries remain with the relevant fund, company, and external providers.

steps.title: Establish mutual fit
keyFacts: Capture founder objectives and select the relevant fund mandate before requesting sensitive information.
painPoints: An attractive business may be outside the mandate; explain a decline without implying a funding commitment.

dependencies.name: Founder Relationships and Origination
dependencies.description: Proposed capability: Manage permissioned founder and advisor relationships, introductions, source context, and stage-specific next decisions.
dependencies.how: Supports this decision through founder relationships and origination.

dependencies.name: Mandate and Opportunity Fit
dependencies.description: Proposed capability: Assess an opportunity against the selected vehicle, strategy, geography, business maturity, and ownership mandate; retain reasons to decline.
dependencies.how: Supports this decision through mandate and opportunity fit.

dependencies.name: Access Boundaries and Audit Evidence
dependencies.description: Proposed capability: Maintain company/fund access boundaries, role approvals, expiry, exportability, and auditable evidence of who accessed or changed sensitive records.
dependencies.how: Supports this decision through access boundaries and audit evidence.

steps.title: Resolve diligence and ownership tradeoffs
keyFacts: Use permissioned evidence to compare seller proceeds, company growth cash, leverage, rollover, and decision rights.
painPoints: An optimistic price can hide debt, product risk, or unacceptable reserved matters.

dependencies.name: Diligence Evidence Exchange
dependencies.description: Proposed capability: Exchange permissioned diligence and exit evidence with document versions, provenance, access expiry, and reviewer questions.
dependencies.how: Supports this decision through diligence evidence exchange.

dependencies.name: Investment Diligence Cases
dependencies.description: Proposed capability: Record financial, commercial, legal, technical, and sustainability workstream findings; separate evidence from management assumptions and unresolved risks.
dependencies.how: Supports this decision through investment diligence cases.

dependencies.name: Capital Structure and Terms
dependencies.description: Proposed capability: Version financing scenarios that separate company cash, seller proceeds, leverage, dilution, investor rights, and downside choices.
dependencies.how: Supports this decision through capital structure and terms.

steps.title: Approve and close the agreed transaction
keyFacts: Record committee decisions and conflicts; reconcile signed conditions and independently verified funding instructions.
painPoints: A material new finding or failed financing condition returns the case for review; a signature alone does not mean cash settled.

dependencies.name: Investment Decisions and Conflicts
dependencies.description: Proposed capability: Preserve authorized investment decisions, dissent, conflicts, fund allocation, conditions, and reapproval after material changes.
dependencies.how: Supports this decision through investment decisions and conflicts.

dependencies.name: Transaction Closing Coordination
dependencies.description: Proposed capability: Coordinate signed conditions, legal entity identifiers, authorization, funding confirmation, and management handover; preserve failed or deferred closing states.
dependencies.how: Supports this decision through transaction closing coordination.

dependencies.name: Ownership and Follow-on Reserves
dependencies.description: Proposed capability: Maintain a reconciled view of stakes, instrument rights, fund allocations, and conditional follow-on reserves without replacing authoritative legal registers.
dependencies.how: Supports this decision through ownership and follow-on reserves.

steps.title: Activate the partnership
keyFacts: Confirm the ownership register, board roles, management responsibilities, and first value-plan milestones.
painPoints: A founder who sells all equity may leave; continuing engagement is not assumed in a full exit.

dependencies.name: Ownership and Follow-on Reserves
dependencies.description: Proposed capability: Maintain a reconciled view of stakes, instrument rights, fund allocations, and conditional follow-on reserves without replacing authoritative legal registers.
dependencies.how: Supports this decision through ownership and follow-on reserves.

dependencies.name: Board Governance and Action Tracking
dependencies.description: Proposed capability: Record company board actions, reserved matters, authority boundaries, escalations, and evidence of completed management actions.
dependencies.how: Supports this decision through board governance and action tracking.

dependencies.name: Value Creation Planning
dependencies.description: Proposed capability: Agree a limited set of company-specific outcomes, baselines, owners, resources, milestones, and stop/continue decisions with management.
dependencies.how: Supports this decision through value creation planning.

dependencies.how: Supports this decision through portfolio performance evidence.

dependencies.name: Value Creation Planning
dependencies.description: Proposed capability: Agree a limited set of company-specific outcomes, baselines, owners, resources, milestones, and stop/continue decisions with management.
dependencies.how: Supports this decision through value creation planning.

dependencies.name: Ownership and Follow-on Reserves

dependencies.how: Supports this decision through ownership and follow-on reserves.

steps.title: Compare funding and operating choices
keyFacts: Model internal and external funding, dilution, lower spending, and a no-new-capital case.
painPoints: Neither an existing stake nor a portfolio relationship guarantees follow-on capital.

dependencies.name: Capital Structure and Terms
dependencies.description: Proposed capability: Version financing scenarios that separate company cash, seller proceeds, leverage, dilution, investor rights, and downside choices.
dependencies.how: Supports this decision through capital structure and terms.

dependencies.name: Ownership and Follow-on Reserves
dependencies.description: Proposed capability: Maintain a reconciled view of stakes, instrument rights, fund allocations, and conditional follow-on reserves without replacing authoritative legal registers.
dependencies.how: Supports this decision through ownership and follow-on reserves.

dependencies.name: Board Governance and Action Tracking
dependencies.description: Proposed capability: Record company board actions, reserved matters, authority boundaries, escalations, and evidence of completed management actions.
dependencies.how: Supports this decision through board governance and action tracking.

steps.title: Review the allocation decision
keyFacts: Document rights, conflicts, fund limits, and approval of the proposed instrument and purpose.
painPoints: An emergency timetable does not remove allocation or authorization requirements.

dependencies.name: Investment Decisions and Conflicts
dependencies.description: Proposed capability: Preserve authorized investment decisions, dissent, conflicts, fund allocation, conditions, and reapproval after material changes.
dependencies.how: Supports this decision through investment decisions and conflicts.

dependencies.name: Investment Diligence Cases
dependencies.description: Proposed capability: Record financial, commercial, legal, technical, and sustainability workstream findings; separate evidence from management assumptions and unresolved risks.
dependencies.how: Supports this decision through investment diligence cases.

steps.title: Close or activate the fallback
keyFacts: Settle approved capital and update rights and milestones; if declined, activate the agreed management contingency.
painPoints: Do not present a financing plan as funded until authoritative settlement evidence exists.

dependencies.name: Transaction Closing Coordination
dependencies.description: Proposed capability: Coordinate signed conditions, legal entity identifiers, authorization, funding confirmation, and management handover; preserve failed or deferred closing states.
dependencies.how: Supports this decision through transaction closing coordination.

dependencies.name: Fund Cash and Distribution Control
dependencies.description: Proposed capability: Reconcile calls, contributions, investment funding, fees, expenses, approved distribution entitlements, and bank settlement across the correct legal entities.
dependencies.how: Supports this decision through fund cash and distribution control.
